**Triage: first-touch grading** — `pm:queue` · `domain:cli` · `priority:p3` · `documentation`. Reading taken in THIS act, 2026-09-20T08:54Z. <sub>本评论来自分诊座位</sub>

**Lands with `collect-docs.ts`'s refusal** ⇒ `domain:cli`.

**`p3` and ⛔ not `bug`**: nothing behaves wrongly. The `docs/duplicate-name` rule **still stands** — what was retired (ADR-0048 §3.4) is the *justification* it used to rest on, the 「one registration overwrites the other」 claim, and `collect-docs.ts`'s message already says so. ⇒ what is owed is **recording what the rule now rests on** (authoring hygiene), which is 纯文档措辞更正 with no contract change — explicitly a 不升级 class.

⭐ **The at-tier reviewer's instinct is the reason this card exists and it is worth endorsing**: it asked for this to be recorded on its own card 「rather than settled inside a widening」. A refusal whose stated justification has been retired deserves its own examination — ⛔ not a sentence smuggled into an unrelated PR where no reviewer is looking for it. ⇒ this seat keeps it as its own card for that reason, ⛔ not because the work is large.

⛔ **Tree staleness note:** the first gate run came from the shared checkout at `e233db9dbb` and printed `STALE TREE` while exiting 0. The reading above was re-derived in a detached worktree at `13d52947d8`. ⇒ check which tree a gate answer read before quoting it.

## ⛔ What this card is NOT

⛔ **Do not relax or remove `docs/duplicate-name`.** The at-tier reviewer's words were *"file it, do not relax it here."* The refusal is **pre-existing** — before the per-package split every doc reached the lint in one flattened array, so two owners on one name already errored. PR #18962 **preserved** it, correctly. ⛔ Nothing in this card is a reason to move an accept set.

## The actual first act, in order

1. **Quote ADR-0048 §3.4 verbatim into the card.** ⛔ Not paraphrased — the whole point is that a retired claim was being relied on second-hand. If the ADR's current text no longer contains the clause, quote what replaced it and say so.
2. **Read what `collect-docs.ts`'s `docs/duplicate-name` message currently asserts**, and set the two side by side.
3. **Decide** whether the message states a justification the ADR still supports.

## Then, and only then

The rule stands as **authoring hygiene** — ⛔ no longer as a statement about what the runtime does (*"one registration overwrites the other"* is the retired claim). The card records `collect-docs.ts`'s message already says so explicitly. ⚠️ **Verify that rather than assuming it** — if it is already correct, the deliverable is the recorded ADR quote plus a measured *"no wording change needed"*, which is a complete and acceptable outcome for this card. ⛔ Do not manufacture an edit to justify the round.

⭐ A finding worth flagging if you hit it: whether any OTHER rule in this file cites a retired justification. ⛔ Do not fix those here — file them.

## Landing record — #19248 is on `main`

PR #19352 merged through the queue at 14:12:06Z. Verified by **content**, ⛔ not by the merge event.

| leg | reading |
|---|---|
| squash commit | `d69f7e1ab9649de52ce01e61364fad5173b56342` — the exact sha the queue branch `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-19352-2b3eb17ddd` predicted |
| shape | `git rev-list --parents -n 1` = **2 fields** ⇒ squash |
| parent | `2b3eb17ddd` (PR #19347's landing — this PR was 2nd from the front of a 6-deep chain) |
| pre-squash head | `9a0331f810` is **NOT** an ancestor of `origin/main` (lit control: the landing commit *is*, so the instrument is live) |

### ⚠️ Verified by TEXT, because this diff has no behaviour to verify

`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts` changed **17 added / 2 removed lines, of which 0 are non-comment**. There is no executable byte to probe, so a behavioural needle would have been meaningless. The needle is docblock text.

| probe | on landing `d69f7e1ab9` | on parent `2b3eb17ddd` |
|---|---|---|
| **needle** — the added ADR quote `two distinct packages coexist on the same bare name` | **1** | 0 |
| **control** — `and is filed rather than changed here`, a line this PR **removed** | 0 | **1** |

⭐ **This control is the one the #19323 landing lacked.** There I picked text that had been added *and* removed inside that PR's own history, so it read 0 on both sides and discriminated nothing. A control has to be something that **existed on the parent** — otherwise it cannot fail, and a check that cannot fail is not a check.

⚠️ The shape check was again not a formality: this PR stored `auto_merge.merge_method` = **`merge`** while the repo sets `allow_merge_commit: false`. It landed at 2 fields. ⇒ the queue's own method governs; ⛔ still check, do not inherit.

### The verdict that landed

§3.4 **still exists** under that number, retires a **runtime throw** and nothing else, and in the same clause hands the surviving class — authoring-time hygiene — to a lint. Both of the rule's messages already state authoring hygiene, and the docblock already declined the retired sentence by name.

⇒ ⭐ **the rule rests on a justification the ADR still supports, so nothing was changed.** What shipped is the record the card asked for: §3.4's two surviving sentences quoted **verbatim** (machine-compared, whitespace-normalised — a first attempt dropped a sentence-final period and was caught *by that check, not by eye*), plus the card number attached to the standing severity disagreement.

⛔ The **severity** question stays open and was correctly not settled here: §3.4 assigns authoring hygiene to a warning-only lint while `docs/duplicate-name` is `severity: 'error'`. That is about the **level**, not the reason, it predates this card, and settling it inside a card about a justification is the exact smuggling #19248 was opened to prevent.

### ⭐ What the round found beyond its own card

A read-only prose sweep was commissioned after the docs-drift check **disclaimed coverage** of this file (*"1 changed file yielded no anchor … this is not a clean bill of health"*). The seat predicted a clean negative. ⛔ **It was wrong** — two surfaces still carry the retired claim, both filed:

- **#19358** — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` teaches that a bare doc name *"would collide across packages and fail at install"* **and cites ADR-0048 as its authority**, the record that retired it. Tier H, customer-published catalog.
- **#19359** — this file's own **module header** states the retired claim as live, while line 929 of the same file declines that sentence by name.

⇒ ⛔ a negative result asserted from expectation is not a measurement. The sweep was worth running precisely because it came back positive.
